declarations.name: Resources.SelectionPolicy.runWith_zero
declarations.source_header:
theorem runWith_zero (choose : List α → Measured (Option α) Nat)
    (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : runWith choose 0 k xs = ((none, []), 1)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionPolicy.runWith_nil

theorem runWith_nil (choose : List α → Measured (Option α) Nat)
    (fuel k : Nat) : runWith choose fuel k [] = ((none, []), 1)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionPolicy.runWith_step
declarations.source_header:
theorem runWith_step (choose : List α → Measured (Option α) Nat)
    (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hx : xs ≠ []) (p : α)
    (hp : (choose xs).1 = some p) :
    runWith choose (fuel + 1) k xs =
      let t := Applications.Selection.partition3 p xs
      let c := (xs.length + 1) + (choose xs).2 + (xs.length + 1) +
        (t.1.length + 1) + (t.2.1.length + 1) + 1
      if k < t.1.length then prepend xs.length c (runWith choose fuel k t.1)
      else if k < t.1.length + t.2.1.length then
        ((t.2.1[k - t.1.length]?, [xs.length]),
          c + (min (k - t.1.length) t.2.1.length + 1))
      else prepend xs.length c
        (runWith choose fuel (k - t.1.length - t.2.1.length) t.2.2)

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionPolicy.runWith_value
declarations.source_header:
theorem runWith_value (choose : List α → Measured (Option α) Nat)
    (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (runWith choose fuel k xs).1.1 =
      Applications.Selection.runWith (fun ys => (choose ys).1) fuel k xs

declarations.name: Resources.SelectionPolicy.runWith_correct
declarations.source_header:
theorem runWith_correct (choose : List α → Measured (Option α) Nat)
    (hv : Applications.Selection.PivotValid (fun ys => (choose ys).1))
    (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (runWith choose fuel k xs).1.1 = (Applications.Selection.ordered xs)[k]?

    (run fuel k xs).1.1 = (ordered xs)[k]?

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.minimum_bucket_sizes
declarations.source_header:
theorem minimum_bucket_sizes (xs : List α) (p : α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hp : Applications.Selection.FixedRank.select0 xs = some p) :
    (partition3 p xs).1.length = 0 ∧ (partition3 p xs).2.1.length = 1 ∧
      (partition3 p xs).2.2.length + 1 = xs.length ∧
      (partition3 p xs).2.2.Nodup

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.run_zero_rank
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_zero_rank (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup) (hx : xs ≠ []) :
    run (fuel + 1) 0 xs =
      ((Applications.Selection.FixedRank.select0 xs, [xs.length]), 3 * xs.length + 8)

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.run_succ_rank
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_succ_rank (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (p : α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hp : Applications.Selection.FixedRank.select0 xs = some p) :
    run (fuel + 1) (k + 1) xs =
      SelectionPolicy.prepend xs.length (3 * xs.length + 7)
        (run fuel k (partition3 p xs).2.2)

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.sizes
declarations.source_header: def sizes (n : Nat) : Nat → List Nat

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.sizes_length
declarations.source_header: theorem sizes_length (n k : Nat) : (sizes n k).length = k + 1

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.run_observations
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_observations (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (run fuel k xs).1.2 = sizes xs.length k ∧
      (run fuel k xs).2 = 3 * (sizes xs.length k).sum + 7 * (k + 1) + 1

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.run_trace
declarations.source_header:
theorem run_trace (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (run fuel k xs).1.2 = sizes xs.length k

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.active_calls
declarations.source_header:

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.recursive_edges

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.sizes_sum_double
declarations.source_header:
theorem sizes_sum_double (n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    2 * (sizes n k).sum + k * (k + 1) = 2 * ((k + 1) * n)

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.sizes_sum
declarations.source_header:
theorem sizes_sum (n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    (sizes n k).sum = (k + 1) * n - k * (k + 1) / 2

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.sizes_sum_bounds
declarations.source_header:
theorem sizes_sum_bounds (n k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    n ≤ (sizes n k).sum ∧ (sizes n k).sum ≤ (k + 1) * n

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.scan_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem scan_exact (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (run fuel k xs).1.2.sum = (k + 1) * xs.length - k * (k + 1) / 2

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.cost_exact
declarations.source_header:
theorem cost_exact (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (run fuel k xs).2 = 3 * (run fuel k xs).1.2.sum + 7 * (k + 1) + 1

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.fixed_rank_linear
declarations.source_header:
theorem fixed_rank_linear (fuel k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hk : k < xs.length) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    xs.length ≤ (run fuel k xs).2 ∧
      (run fuel k xs).2 ≤ (10 * (k + 1) + 1) * xs.length

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.largest_scan_double
declarations.source_header:
theorem largest_scan_double (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hx : xs ≠ []) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    2 * (run fuel (xs.length - 1) xs).1.2.sum = xs.length * (xs.length + 1)

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.largest_scan
declarations.source_header:
theorem largest_scan (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hx : xs ≠ []) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    (run fuel (xs.length - 1) xs).1.2.sum = xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2

declarations.name: Resources.MinimumPivot.largest_cost_quadratic
declarations.source_header:
theorem largest_cost_quadratic (fuel : Nat) (xs : List α) (hn : xs.Nodup)
    (hx : xs ≠ []) (hf : xs.length ≤ fuel) :
    xs.length ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (run fuel (xs.length - 1) xs).2 ∧
      (run fuel (xs.length - 1) xs).2 ≤ 11 * xs.length ^ 2
